title: SreOperationsCenterContract
description: Target/spec contract for Oyatie's SRE Operations Center slice: service health, on-call escalation, incident command, customer/status communication, error-budget release decisions, postmortem evidence, and retention boundaries. This contract intentionally does not claim live monitoring, paging, status-page operation, or production readiness.

_meta.source_request: SREOPS-001: on-call incident status operations center contract
non_goals: Do not stand up production monitoring, paging, or status-page providers in this contract.
Do not promise live on-call coverage, production readiness, or hyperscaler-grade operations.
Do not duplicate OPS-001, DR-001, RELEASE-001, OBS-004, RESILIENCE-001, Trust Center, or support/advisory implementation slices; link to them as consumers or producers.
Do not expose tenant-specific, regulated, security-sensitive, or personal data through public status surfaces.
Do not add new legacy oya CLI authority or hand-edit generated faces.

allowed_claims_now: Oyatie has a proposed SRE Operations Center product/control-plane contract.
The contract defines records, workflows, UI surfaces, claim ceilings, and verification paths needed before implementation slices can claim operational readiness.
Existing OPS/DR/RELEASE/OBS/RESILIENCE Kanban cards are linked as implementation sub-slices rather than duplicated here.
forbidden_claims_until_evidence_exists: customer status page or incident communications are live
SLO/error-budget release freezes are mechanically enforced
production-ready, hyperscaler-grade, secure, isolated, done, or fully automated operations
promotion_requirements: service inventory record for each claimed service
OpenTelemetry traces/metrics/log fixtures and measured SLO windows
browser/user-story evidence for operator incident command and customer/status publication paths
security and privacy review for retained incident/customer-impact evidence
RED/GREEN fixtures for missing required records and unsafe public disclosure
cloud-ci or release-promotion gate evidence before any mechanically-enforced claim
IncidentPostmortemRecord and ActionItemLink ledger evidence for qualifying incidents, including DRI ownership, due dates, recurrence-prevention proof, customer-impact redaction, and closeout proof
30-day sustained green window or explicit new-service exception before production-ready claims

requires ops-dashboard/control-center, incident/deployment/tenant-policy/audit/recovery workflows, SLO error-budget gating, progressive delivery/rollback, and runbooks/incident response
requires ops-dashboard-control-center as a first deliverable surface and full-depth incident/deployment/recovery evidence
target observability/SLO model; explicitly no collector, SLO engine, dashboards, or measured evidence implemented
accepted public-status-page decision: routine SLO health is projector-derived, while incident narrative requires incident-response authored updates and tenant-safe subscriber surfaces
claim tiers and required evidence for SLO/error-budget, observability/operations, release safety, on-call escalation, and incident/postmortem process
quality-bar verification taxonomy for implementation, verification, documentation, operational, security, critic, and closeout evidence classes
tenant-scoped Trust Center / Compliance Evidence Portal contract consuming status, incident, SLO, DR, release, advisory, and audit-chain evidence without cross-tenant disclosure
ops/workspace includes reserved on-call and incident bounded contexts
ops.oyatie.com surface inventory names on-call and incident as Wave 6 targets

personas.role: Receives actionable pages, acknowledges incidents, executes runbooks, records mitigation evidence, and escalates when thresholds or expertise boundaries are crossed.
Owns severity declaration, incident room coordination, role assignment, customer-impact classification, rollback/freeze decisions, and resolution handoff.
Owns the service catalog record, SLOs, runbooks, dependencies, operational readiness, postmortem actions, and launch-readiness signoff for one service.
Connects release/canary progress to SLO burn, freeze/throttle/rollback policy, and release exception evidence.
Publishes approved customer-visible incident updates without leaking tenant-confidential, regulated, security-sensitive, personal, or secret data.
Approves disclosures and evidence retention when an incident may involve security, regulated jurisdictions, tenant data, PII, PHI, financial data, or secrets.
Consumes scoped customer-impact status, support case links, trusted-advisor recommendations, and resolution evidence for affected tenants only.

domain_workflows.goal: Every service that wants operational-readiness claims has an owner, SLOs, runbooks, dependencies, customer-impact model, and health/status projection.
minimum_flow: register service and ownership
bind SLOs and golden signals
bind runbooks and alerts
declare customer/status projection rules
publish read-only health snapshot for operators
domain_workflows.claim_gate: Cannot claim production-ready for a service until this record is complete and backed by measured evidence.

domain_workflows.goal: Route high-severity alarms to accountable humans or teams with bounded acknowledgement, escalation, and handoff evidence.
minimum_flow: alert fires from SLO/burn-rate/high-severity rule
page created with service, severity, runbook, and dedupe key
on-call acknowledges or escalates
handoff records preserve continuity
paging-quality review classifies false positive, duplicate, unactionable, or useful page
domain_workflows.claim_gate: On-call coverage remains a target until rotation, contact, acknowledgement, escalation, and paging-quality evidence exist.

domain_workflows.goal: Turn alerts, user reports, or operator discoveries into structured incident command evidence with roles, timeline, severity, customer impact, mitigation, and closure.
domain_workflows.claim_gate: Structured incident process remains target/spec until state transitions, audit events, and role assignments are implemented and tested.

domain_workflows.goal: Produce approved, audience-scoped incident communication for public status, tenant-specific customer notifications, support cases, and trust-center evidence without leaking protected data.
minimum_flow: classify affected services, regions, tenants, and data classes
draft public/customer/internal updates separately
obtain incident commander approval
obtain security/privacy approval when data classes or security impact require it
publish/retract/update through the selected channel
retain immutable evidence of what was sent to whom and when
domain_workflows.claim_gate: Customer communication remains target/spec until SREOPS-001A implements fixtures and browser/user-story evidence.

domain_workflows.goal: Bind SLO burn and incident severity to release freeze, throttling, rollback, brownout, and feature-flag cleanup decisions.
minimum_flow: consume OpenSLO/error-budget state
calculate burn-rate decision tier
record freeze/throttle/rollback decision with owner and expiry
link to release/canary/feature-flag state
emit audit event for exception or override
domain_workflows.claim_gate: Mechanically-enforced release freeze or rollback requires OBS-004/RELEASE-001 implementation plus protected gate evidence.

domain_workflows.goal: Preserve blameless postmortem evidence, recurrence-prevention action items, DRI ownership, due dates, and closure proof for qualifying incidents.
minimum_flow: decide whether postmortem is required from severity/customer-impact/data-class policy
record summary, contributing factors, timeline, detection gaps, and mitigation
link release, DR, SLO, support, and customer communication evidence
create action items with owner, due date, verification, and escalation
close only after evidence proves the recurrence-prevention action landed or an explicit risk acceptance exists
domain_workflows.claim_gate: Postmortem process remains target/spec until SREOPS-001B implements fixture/gate coverage.

api_and_evidence_records.purpose: Read-only operational summary for one service/component/cell/region.
Defines accountable on-call coverage without exposing private contact details to broad viewers.
Durable incident command source of truth.
Append-only timeline entry for detection, role assignment, mitigation, customer update, rollback, or closure.
Typed audience and routing contract for deciding which public, internal, support, Trust Center, or tenant-scoped viewers may receive which incident communication payload.
Evidence for public status, tenant-scoped notifications, support/advisory updates, and retractions.
Evidence for release freeze, throttle, rollback, brownout, or exception decisions.
Blameless incident review and recurrence-prevention evidence.
Durable recurrence-prevention action item linked to one postmortem with DRI, due-date, escalation, verification, and closeout evidence.
Feedback loop for alert quality, toil, false positives, duplicate pages, and actionability.

api_surface_contract.style: typed API/evidence records first; UI and automation consume these records instead of CLI or shell scraping
invariants: Every mutating endpoint emits an audit-chain event.
Public status records must be derivable from internal incident records only through a redaction/approval step.
Tenant-scoped communications must prove tenant audience filtering and may not be exposed through public status APIs.
CustomerImpactAudience is the only routing source for customer-scoped status payloads; raw tenant lists stay behind tenant-config references.
StatusCommunicationRecord publish/retract operations require a prior approval_state that matches the incident impact data classes and audience kind.
Secret contact data and notification provider tokens are referenced through secret handles only and are never logged or returned to UI clients.

Qualifying Sev-1/Sev-2, customer-impacting, security/privacy, data-loss, or error-budget-exhaustion incidents cannot enter closed state until IncidentPostmortemRecord required fields are present or a risk_acceptance_ref is approved.

Postmortems with required action items cannot close until every ActionItemLink is closed with recurrence-prevention evidence, verification evidence, and closeout proof, or has explicit risk acceptance.
Release freeze, rollback, throttle, brownout, or exception decisions caused by incidents must be linked from postmortem evidence back to ErrorBudgetDecisionRecord and release/canary state.
Mechanically-enforced release decisions cannot be claimed until release/observability gates own the protected context.

customer_incident_communications_contrac.scope: SREOPS-001A customer-facing incident communications contract; target/spec only and not a live status page, pager, or external notification provider.

data_class_policy.public_status: May include public incident id, severity/state, affected product/service names, broad public regions, redacted summary, next-update time, mitigation/resolution text, and public postmortem/trust-center links after approval.
data_class_policy.internal_only: May include operator timeline, owner teams, runbook refs, release decisions, audit ids, unreleased mitigation details, and redaction-review state for SRE/support/security viewers.
data_class_policy.customer_scoped: May include tenant-specific impact, workaround, support case refs, advisory refs, and trust-center evidence refs only after CustomerImpactAudience filtering proves the viewer is in scope.
data_class_policy.regulated_or_security_sensitive: Any security impact, regulated jurisdiction, tenant-data, pii, phi, financial, or secret-related incident requires security/privacy approval before publish and must keep raw detail out of public status surfaces.

status_communication_record_fixtures.published_text_redacted: We are investigating elevated latency for Mail API in one US region. Customer data remains protected. Next update by 15:00 UTC.
A subset of tenants in KR cell 1 may see delayed workflow execution. Use manual approval fallback documented in the linked advisory until mitigation is confirmed.
Correction: the earlier Mail API latency notice was scoped to webhook delivery, not inbound mail receipt. Historical status entry retained with this correction.

surface_links.public_status_page: ADR-0168 status.oya.dev / Statuspage-compatible projector consumes only public redacted incident narrative and SLO health state.
surface_links.tenant_console_advisory: Customer-scoped console advisory renders tenant-specific workaround/status only after CustomerImpactAudience filtering.
surface_links.support_handoff: Support/customer-success receives scoped case/advisory refs, workaround, next update time, and final-resolution summary; raw incident details remain internal unless separately authorized.
surface_links.trust_center: /specs/trust-center-compliance-evidence-portal.json consumes approved incident/status evidence for tenant evidence rooms and public trust-center summaries without certification or cross-tenant claims.

customer_incident_communications_contrac.claim_ceiling: Target/spec contract only until browser/user-story evidence proves publish, correction, and retraction flows; OTel/OpenSLO fixtures prove source incident/status state; RED/GREEN disclosure fixtures prove public vs tenant-scoped filtering; and support/trust-center handoff evidence exists.

postmortem_action_item_ledger_contract.scope: Spec-ready evidence contract for the SREOPS-001B lane; no runtime incident review, ticketing system, or production-readiness claim is created by this spec.

required_for: SLO error-budget exhaustion or release freeze/rollback decision
incident commander or service owner DRI override
not_required_requires: redacted rationale retained in audit evidence

closed_requires: scoped_evidence_refs for retained postmortem/customer-impact evidence and security_privacy_review_ref when security, privacy, regulated, tenant-data, pii, phi, financial, or secret exposure is possible
error_budget_decision_refs when SLO burn, freeze, rollback, throttle, brownout, or exception affected the incident
all ActionItemLink rows closed with verification_evidence_ref and closeout_proof_ref, or risk_acceptance_ref present
closeout_state_machine.overdue_escalation: If due_at passes before closed/risk_accepted, emit EVT-SRE-ACTION-ITEM-OVERDUE-ESCALATED for each open ActionItemLink and page/escalate using overdue_escalation_policy_id.

action_item_contract.owner_model: Every ActionItemLink has one owner_dri_principal_ref and one owner_team; group-only ownership is not enough for closeout.
action_item_contract.due_date_model: due_at is mandatory, extensions require an audit event and either DRI approval or risk_acceptance_ref.
action_item_contract.recurrence_prevention_evidence: Action item closeout must point at the landed fix, guard, test, runbook, gate, rollout, or explicit risk acceptance that reduces recurrence likelihood; narrative-only closure is insufficient.
action_item_contract.verification_evidence: verification_evidence_ref must map to the relevant /specs/evidence-taxonomy.json class and include command/lane/result or browser/API/operational proof proportional to the artifact type.
action_item_contract.closeout_proof: closeout_proof_ref records current-head evidence and reviewer/DRI approval; it must not contain raw secrets, raw tenant identifiers, or unredacted PII.

required_when: release freeze/throttle/rollback/brownout decision occurred during mitigation
postmortem action changes release policy, canary policy, feature flag cleanup, or automatic rollback criteria
error_budget_release_integration.claim_gate: Error-budget release freeze/rollback remains target/spec until OBS-004 and RELEASE-001 implementation evidence owns the protected gate.

quality_bar_taxonomy_mapping.implementation: record schemas/API/UI contract changed at cited paths
quality_bar_taxonomy_mapping.verification: JSON parse, RED/GREEN fixture plan, API/contract replay, or gate output captured with current result
quality_bar_taxonomy_mapping.documentation: operator postmortem/runbook/customer-impact documentation updated or explicitly N/A
quality_bar_taxonomy_mapping.operational: incident/release/rollback/observability evidence exists for runtime claims; target/spec lanes must state the gap
quality_bar_taxonomy_mapping.security: redaction, retention, tenant scope, regulated data, and secret-handle review completed before retained evidence is exposed
quality_bar_taxonomy_mapping.critic: independent review of recurrence-prevention sufficiency and false-green risk
quality_bar_taxonomy_mapping.closeout: board/PR/review/evidence handoff proves the action item closed at current head or risk was accepted

privacy_and_retention_rules: Customer-impact summaries stored in public/status evidence must be redacted derivatives of internal incident detail.
Raw tenant data, raw PII/PHI/financial data, secrets, and security exploit detail are retained only by scoped evidence refs with data-class labels and retention_policy_id.
Security/privacy review is required before postmortem evidence is exported to Trust Center, support, auditor-room, or public status surfaces.

ui_components.purpose: Operator landing page with service health, current incidents, error-budget freezes, and on-call coverage gaps.
Service owner view of SLOs, golden signals, dependencies, runbooks, release state, incidents, DR evidence, and quality-bar gaps.
Incident commander and responders coordinate roles, timeline, decisions, mitigation, customer impact, and follow-ups.
Draft, approve, publish, retract, and retain public/customer-scoped incident updates with data-class redaction checks.
Shows SLO burn, freeze/throttle/rollback decisions, release exceptions, and feature-flag cleanup state.
Tracks postmortem due dates, recurrence-prevention actions, owners, verification, escalation, and closure evidence.
Classifies pages by actionability/noise/toil and creates follow-up work for alert quality.

data_boundary_rules: Use docs/standards/data-class.md taxonomy: public, internal, tenant-config, tenant-data, pii, phi, financial, secret, regulated-jurisdiction.
Incident records may reference PII, tenant-data, regulated-jurisdiction markers, or secrets only through scoped references and redacted evidence bundles.
Public status and customer communication records must be derived from approved redacted text, not raw incident detail.
Customer-scoped status/advisory payloads must carry a CustomerImpactAudience reference and tenant-filter reference; public status payloads must never carry raw tenant identifiers.
Security/privacy review is mandatory before publishing any update involving security impact, regulated jurisdictions, tenant-data, pii, phi, financial data, or possible secret exposure.
Retention policies must state jurisdiction, incident severity, customer-impact class, and erasure/redaction behavior.
